newsitem.title: UK: Major lays plans to stay in power until May - report.
newsitem.headline: Major lays plans to stay in power until May - report.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major is planning to exploit a range of obscure parliamentary devices to ensure he stays in power until next May, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
The report, which did not cite sources, said Major was planning to withstand pressure to call an early general election even though he has already lost his majority in the House of Commons.

A number of Conservative MPs have threatened to refuse to cooperate with the government over its stance on Europe, further weakening its position. A general election must be held by May 22 at the latest.

The Financial Times said government managers believed the ruling Conservative Party would be able to keep its key majority on House of Commons committees, which are vital to the government's ability to legislate.
